projects.title: Yeneschool
projects.summary: A complete school administration platform handling students, staff, academics, and finances in one place.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Schools juggle a dozen disconnected tools—attendance books, grade sheets, fee ledgers, and parent communication. Managing this manually is slow, error-prone, and scales poorly as the school grows.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: I built a unified school management system that brings student records, staff management, class scheduling, attendance tracking, grading, and fee management into a single, easy-to-use dashboard.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Student and staff profile management, academic records with grade tracking, fee and payment management, role-based access for admins, teachers, and staff, and responsive design for use on any device.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: The system removes hours of manual administrative work each week, centralizes data in one reliable place, and gives school leaders real-time insight into attendance, grades, and finances.

projects.title: Fenaid
projects.summary: An intellectual and physical disability organization platform that helps children access support and resources.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Families of children with intellectual and physical disabilities struggle to find coordinated support, resources, and services in one place. Existing systems are fragmented and hard to navigate.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: I built a platform that connects families with therapists, educators, and support services, providing a centralized hub for resource discovery, appointment scheduling, and progress tracking.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Disability resource directory, appointment scheduling, progress tracking for children, role-based access for families and service providers, and accessible design for all users.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Helps families find the right support faster and gives service providers a streamlined way to manage their caseloads and track outcomes.

projects.title: Mykeycoffe
projects.summary: A coffee marketplace inspired by Arabia, featuring multiple categories and a seamless ordering experience.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Coffee lovers in the region need a platform that brings together specialty coffee shops, brewing methods, and product categories in one curated experience.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: I built a coffee marketplace with multiple categories—espresso, filter, cold brew, and more—alongside shop profiles, product listings, and a smooth ordering flow.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Category-based browsing, shop profiles with menus, product search and filtering, cart and checkout flow, and responsive design for mobile and desktop.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Connects coffee shops with customers and provides a modern, curated coffee shopping experience inspired by Arabian coffee culture.

projects.title: Saftex Garment
projects.summary: An inventory management system that handles multi-branching for clothes and uniforms.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Garment businesses with multiple branches struggle to track inventory across locations, manage stock levels, and coordinate uniform distribution efficiently.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: I built a centralized inventory management system that handles multi-branch stock tracking, uniform allocation, and real-time inventory visibility across all locations.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Multi-branch inventory tracking, uniform allocation and management, real-time stock levels, category-based organization for clothes and uniforms, and role-based access for branch managers.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Eliminates manual inventory tracking across branches, reduces stock discrepancies, and provides real-time visibility into inventory levels across all locations.
